info.title: CKAN REST API
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the CKAN Open Data Portal API, split into subfiles using JSON `$ref` references.

## Architecture

CKAN exposes a single RPC-style **Action API** endpoint. All actions are called by POST (or GET for read-only actions) to:

```
POST /api/3/action/{action_name}
GET  /api/3/action/{action_name}?param=value
```

Every response is a JSON envelope `{success, result, error, help}`. Check `success` before using `result`.

## Authentication

Pass an API token in the `Authorization` header (preferred) or legacy `X-CKAN-API-Key` header.
Generate tokens at **User Profile → Manage → API Tokens** or via `api_token_create`.

## Directory structure

```
openapi.json                          ← root entry point
components/
  schemas/          (23 files)         ← shared data models
  parameters/       (4 files)          ← shared parameters
  responses/        (4 files)          ← shared error responses
  securitySchemes/  (2 files)
paths/
  core_get/         (29 files)         ← read-only CKAN core actions
  core_create/      (14 files)         ← create actions
  core_update/      (12 files)         ← update/replace actions
  core_patch/       (5 files)          ← partial update actions
  core_delete/      (19 files)         ← delete/purge actions
  core_file/        (6 files)          ← CKAN 2.12+ File API
  datastore/        (10 files)         ← ckanext-datastore
  filestore/        (1 file)           ← DataStore dump download
  activity/         (15 files)         ← ckanext-activity
  harvest/          (13 files)         ← ckanext-harvest
  spatial/          (1 file)           ← ckanext-spatial
  dcat/             (3 files)          ← ckanext-dcat
```

## Coverage

**Core API** (ckan.logic.action): `package_*`, `resource_*`, `group_*`, `organization_*`, `user_*`, `tag_*`, `vocabulary_*`, `member_*`, `api_token_*`, `config_option_*`, `job_*`, `file_*`

**ckanext-datastore**: `datastore_create`, `datastore_upsert`, `datastore_search`, `datastore_search_sql`, `datastore_delete`, `datastore_records_delete`, `datastore_info`, `datastore_run_triggers`, `datastore_function_create/delete`

**ckanext-activity**: activity stream listing, creating, diffing, deleting, email notifications

**ckanext-harvest**: `harvest_source_*`, `harvest_job_*`, `harvest_object_*`, `harvesters_info_show`

**ckanext-spatial**: `ext_bbox` bounding-box search extension to `package_search`

**ckanext-dcat**: `/catalog.{format}`, `/dataset/{id}.{format}`, Schema.org structured data

**FileStore (dump)**: `GET /datastore/dump/{resource_id}`

post.summary: Create or alter a DataStore table
post.description:
Creates a new table in the DataStore for a resource, or alters an existing one to add/remove fields, change aliases, set indexes, and bulk-insert records.

To simultaneously create a CKAN resource and its DataStore table, omit `resource_id` and provide a `resource` dict with a valid `package_id`.

resource_id.description: Id of the existing resource. Omit when using `resource` to create a new resource simultaneously.

resource.description: Resource dict (used to create a new CKAN resource at the same time). Requires `package_id`.

primary_key.description: List or comma-separated string of primary key field ids.

aliases.description: Read-only alias names for the table.

triggers.description: PL/pgSQL trigger functions to run on insert/update.

force.description: Set True to edit a read-only table.

calculate_record_count.description: Update record count: True, False, or 'background'.

post.summary: Insert or update records in a DataStore table
post.description:
Insert, update, or upsert records into an existing DataStore table.

**Methods:**
- `upsert` (default) — update if key exists, otherwise insert. Requires primary key.
- `insert` — fast insert only; fails on duplicates.
- `update` — update only; fails if key not found. Requires primary key.

dry_run.description: Abort transaction to check for validation errors without committing.

get.description:
Search, filter, and paginate data in a DataStore resource. By default returns 100 rows.

A public DataStore resource can be read without authentication. Private resources require an API token.

All parameters can also be sent as a JSON POST body.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Resource id or alias (e.g. `_table_metadata` to list all tables).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON dict of equality or comparison filters. E.g. `{"name":"fred"}` or `{"year":{"lt":2020}}`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search string across all fields, or JSON dict `{field: value}` for per-field search.

parameters.name: plain
parameters.description: Treat query as plain text (vs PostgreSQL tsquery syntax).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated or JSON array of fields to return.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort expression. E.g. `fieldname1, fieldname2 desc nulls last`.

post.description: Same as GET. Use POST for longer queries.

Run a raw PostgreSQL SELECT query across DataStore tables. Allows JOINs between resources.

Must be enabled with `ckan.datastore.sqlsearch.enabled = True` in CKAN config. Subject to a query timeout. Results capped at 32000 rows (configurable). Requires read access to all referenced resources.

Delete records from a DataStore table using filters, OR drop the entire table if no filters are provided.

⚠️ Omitting `filters` permanently drops the table and its data dictionary.

filters.description: Row filters. If omitted, the entire table is deleted.

200.description: Original filters and deleted records list

post.summary: Delete DataStore records (never drops the table)
post.description: Delete rows matching filters from a DataStore table. The table structure is preserved. Pass `filters: {}` to delete all rows.

filters.description: Row filters. Pass `{}` to delete all rows.

get.description: Return detailed metadata about a DataStore table including fields, indexes, aliases, row count, and storage size.

post.summary: Re-run triggers on all DataStore rows
post.description: Re-applies all existing trigger functions to every row in a DataStore table. Useful to revalidate/clean data after adding a new trigger.
Create or replace a PL/pgSQL trigger function for use with `datastore_create` triggers. Only trigger functions with `rettype = 'trigger'` are supported. Sysadmin only.
Delete a PL/pgSQL trigger function by name. Sysadmin only.

get.summary: Search datasets with spatial bounding box filter
get.description:
Extends the core `package_search` action with an `ext_bbox` parameter to filter datasets by spatial extent.

Requires the `spatial_query` and `spatial_metadata` plugins.

**This is not a separate action** — it extends `/api/3/action/package_search` with extra parameter `ext_bbox`.

parameters.name: ext_bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box in the form `minx,miny,maxx,maxy` (WGS84 decimal degrees). Datasets whose `spatial` extra field overlaps this bbox are returned.

parameters.name: ext_prev_extent
parameters.description: Previous map extent `minx,miny,maxx,maxy` for spatial sorting relevance.

200.description: Standard package_search result with spatial filtering applied

get.description:
Returns the entire catalog of datasets in the requested RDF serialization format. Results are paginated.

**URL:** `{ckan-host}/catalog.{format}`

Default base path (`/catalog.{format}`) can be overridden with `ckanext.dcat.catalog_endpoint` config option.

**Supported formats:** `rdf` (XML), `ttl` (Turtle), `n3`, `jsonld`, `xml`

**Content negotiation:** When `ckanext.dcat.enable_content_negotiation = True`, the catalog is also available at the root URL (`/`) via `Accept` header.

parameters.name: modified_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime — return only datasets modified after this date.

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of RDF profiles to use (e.g. `euro_dcat_ap_2,schemaorg`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Solr full-text search query to filter catalog contents.

get.summary: Get a single dataset as RDF/DCAT
get.description:
Returns a single dataset in the requested RDF serialization format as DCAT.

**URL:** `{ckan-host}/dataset/{dataset-id}.{format}`

The `.{format}` extension is appended to the standard CKAN dataset URL.

**Content negotiation:** If `ckanext.dcat.enable_content_negotiation = True`, the dataset page URL accepts `Accept` headers like `text/turtle` or `application/ld+json`.

get.summary: Get a dataset as Schema.org JSON-LD for Google Dataset Search
get.description:
Returns Schema.org structured data for a dataset as JSON-LD. Embedded in the dataset page HTML when `structured_data` plugin is enabled. Improves Google Dataset Search indexing.

**URL:** `{ckan-host}/api/3/action/package_show?id={id}` — same as `package_show`, but when the `structured_data` plugin is enabled, a `<script type='application/ld+json'>` tag is injected on the dataset page with schema.org metadata.

This endpoint documents the data format — not a separate API endpoint.

ApiToken.name: Authorization
ApiToken.description: CKAN API token. Generate via User Profile → Manage → API Tokens or via `api_token_create`. Pass the raw token value (no prefix).

XCKANHeader.name: X-CKAN-API-Key
XCKANHeader.description: Legacy CKAN API key header (still accepted on most instances). Prefer Authorization header with API tokens.

id.name: id
id.description: The id or name of the object.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Offset to start returning results from (for pagination).

Success.description: Action succeeded. Check `success: true` in body.

AuthError.description: Authorization error — not authenticated or insufficient privileges.

NotFound.description: Not Found — the requested object does not exist.

ValidationError.description: Validation Error — the request body failed validation.

ActionResponse.description: Standard CKAN Action API response envelope.

result.description: The returned data. Type varies by action.

help.description: URL of the help text for the action that was called.

name.description: URL-safe lowercase identifier. Unique across the site.

owner_org.description: Organization id or name that owns the dataset.

Resource.description: A data resource attached to a CKAN dataset.

datastore_active.description: True if this resource has been pushed into the DataStore.

url_type.description: 'upload' for FileStore uploads, empty for external URLs.

Group.description: A CKAN group (thematic collection of datasets).

vocabulary_id.description: Present if the tag belongs to a vocabulary. Null for free tags.

info.description: Data Dictionary metadata for this field.

HarvestSource.description: A harvest source (represented as a special CKAN dataset of type `harvest`).

url.description: URL of the remote source to harvest.

config.description: JSON string with harvester-specific configuration options.

HarvestJob.description: A single run of a harvest source.

ActivityItem.description: An activity stream entry recording a change made in CKAN.

ResourceView.description: A view of a resource (e.g. data table, chart, map).
